question: Does a shared learned recurrent update conditioned on a public query depth transfer from 3–6 exactly-hop paths to previously unseen lengths 7–8?
hypothesis: Variable-depth recurrent readout with a task-trained 5-scalar update has greater exact-depth discriminative power than the same initialized readout or frozen depth-blind model, holding a frozen 257-parameter identity projection fixed.
